brief: GS's Friday Mark to Market: risk fell into the weekend but bounced off the day's lows into the close. NDX posted its worst session since June as the AI trade was hit hard after earnings. The GS AI Semis basket (GSCBSMHX) fell 8.25% on the week, and the GS Data Center basket (GSTMTDAT) fell 7.35%. SPX fell 182bps to 7580, NDX fell 346bps to 28384, and RTY fell 166bps to 2811, while 6 of 11 sectors stayed green on a rotation into defensives. Equity weakness drove a choppy, steeper-curve rates session, with real money paying rate and buyers of spreads. Q3 ECI came in line, and the market closes the week pricing 18bps of hikes by year-end and 60bps by mid-2027. Credit followed equities wider (CDX IG +0.64bps, CDX HY -20cts) after poor AI sentiment soured an early bounce. TMT cash underperformed on hyperscaler and AI weakness, and CRWV cash drifted lower. VRRM bonds fell 9pts, and no primary deals priced. The Dollar weakened against most G10 peers. EUR was the only currency to close red, at its lowest since May '25, while JPY's risk-off gains underscored its hedge value. Next week brings payrolls, ISM, the Nov QRA, and midterms.
